entities.summary: The Church of the Intercession of the Virgin Mary or more formally Church of the Intercession of the Virgin Mary, Queen of the Holy Rosary is a Catholic church in Tomsk, Russia. under the patronage of the intercession of the Blessed Virgin Mary. Tomsk, a city known for its universities and rich historical tradition, is located within the Roman Catholic Diocese of the Transfiguration at Novosibirsk.
